errors.text_span: Two sets of bars are presented for each model; the first set, in blue, represents MMAU performance, and the second set, in purple, represents MMAR performance.
errors.evidence: The phrasing "Two sets of bars" and subsequently "the first set" and "the second set" is awkward and confusing. The chart displays two individual bars for each model, not two "sets".
The MMAU bar for the 'Audio-Reasoner' category is visibly above the 60% line, at approximately 62%. Describing it as 'around 60%' is an underestimate.
